thread.title: Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak hasn’t fallen victim to trillion-dollar-market-cap mania - MarketWatch

author: Tim Rostan
title: Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak hasn’t fallen victim to trillion-dollar-market-cap mania - MarketWatch
text:
Company co-founder Steve Wozniak is aware of the clamor this week over Apple’s rapidly accelerated assault on the trillion-dollar-market-cap distinction, but, according to a Yahoo Finance report , he’s far from fixated on it.
In the words of Wozniak, who founded Apple 42 years ago alongside the legendary Steve Jobs , remaining with the company full-time till 1985:
‘Of course I’m proud of Apple, but I don’t measure the world by human simplifications like round numbers. A company is great because it is great.’ Steve Wozniak If Apple’s stock AAPL, +2.92% closes above $207.04, as it appears Thursday increasingly likely to do, it would become the first U.S.-listed company in history to be valued at $1 trillion .
